required_activities: A01-A04, A07-A17 exception queue, A21 human service, A25-A26, payment release (one of two)
driver: account-level human minutes (mix) + sponsor configuration minutes
threshold_formula: core FTE = max(2, ceil(annual x 1.15 / 82,080), smallest core whose 31 Dec backlog (with prep-only surge) clears within 10 January working days); annual = N x m_acct + S x s_cfg
peak_factor: December peak-week day ~= 4.7x average account-level day (0.265 x 0.5 / 7 x 250) [D/A]; core sized so the 31 Dec backlog clears in 10 January working days
absence_cover: second trained releaser + pre-appointed backup releaser (controller cannot be the second releaser on payments it reconciles)
authority: prepare; release as one of two/three distinct persons; no reserved decisions
sla: exceptions within sponsor-set business days; complaints acknowledged in 2 business days (CNV-PLT-005)
failure_consequence: late grants, missed year-end dating, dual control collapse
replaces_prior_trigger: none (prior: ops manager after 4 added ops staff)

role: Sponsor-appointed decision-maker (sponsor staff or contracted, NOT servicer)
required_activities: A05 acceptance, A11 exception decisions, A12 flag clearing escalations, discretionary holds, delegation adoption
driver: exceptions x decision minutes per sponsor
handling_time: 5 min per exception decision; 30 min per complex gift [A]
threshold_formula: per sponsor: >= 2 appointees (primary + backup) + pre-appointed December surge reviewer; capacity rarely binding
absence_cover: named backup appointee per decision class; double absence tested as December stress (CNV-GOV-004)
independence: cannot be servicer staff (CNV-GOV-004: vendor staff SHALL NOT hold A3+)
replaces_prior_trigger: new (not in prior model; a cost the buyer bears)

required_activities: S01 close and sign-off, unattributable-break decisions, tolerance approval for new sources, fee basis, Schedule D bridge
driver: sponsors (books) + new feed sources + break volume; NOT accounts
frequency_basis: per sponsor-month; per new source; per break
handling_time: 150 min sign-off per sponsor-month; ProvisionalCalibration: 100% review one close cycle per new source [A]
units_per_hour_or_capacity: about 60-75 sponsor-books per controller-year at 1,000-1,300 min each before close work [E]
threshold_formula: add a senior accountant when S x 12 x (sign-off + close review) + new_sources x calibration + breaks x 10 > 0.8 x 82,080
absence_cover: fractional/contracted controller pre-appointed as backup; sign-off may wait <= sponsor-set days
failure_consequence: statements blocked for affected funds; audit qualification
replaces_prior_trigger: replaces part of 'fund accountant per 15,000 accounts'

required_activities: A18 break resolution, A19 fee posting checks, custodian/advisor feed exceptions, unknown payment outcomes (CNV-PAY-004)
driver: breaks = transactions x break rate + new sources x calibration items
frequency_basis: per transaction (break rate 0.3-1% [A]); per new source
handling_time: 10 min per break; calibration 100% non-exact review for one cycle [A]
units_per_hour_or_capacity: about 8,000 breaks per FTE-year at 10 min [D]
threshold_formula: FTE = ceil((T x b x 10 + calibration_items x 5) / 82,080); 0 until > 0.5 FTE (controller or outsourced bookkeeping covers)
absence_cover: outsourced reconciliation provider as backup (CNV-GOV-003 allows internal or outsourced)
authority: prepare and resolve breaks; no payment rights
independence: must not prepare or release payments
sla: exception review within sponsor-set business days
failure_consequence: unexplained breaks block statements for affected funds
replaces_prior_trigger: replaces 'fund accountant per 15,000 accounts': scales with transactions x break rate and sources, not accounts

required_activities: A24 match dispositions, OFAC blocking/reject reports, A10 adverse events, Tier-2 policy, fraud case oversight, regulatory change into policy packs
driver: alerts + Tier-2 triggers + regulatory change; a named owner from day 1
frequency_basis: per screened event; per adverse event; per regulatory change
handling_time: 15 min per adverse event; 20-60 min per true-match case [A]
threshold_formula: named fractional owner from go-live; employ when compliance minutes > 0.5 x 82,080 or any sponsor contract requires an employee
authority: disposition proposals; report filing preparation; reserved blocks via sponsor officer
independence: independent of grant preparation for dispositions
sla: OFAC reports within 10 business days (31 CFR 501.603/604 via CNV-GRT-006)
failure_consequence: regulatory penalty exposure; unblocked prohibited payment
replaces_prior_trigger: replaces 'compliance officer above 10,000 accounts' (accounts are a poor proxy)

required_activities: CNV-GRT-011 sampling of delegated approvals; CNV-FIN-004 attestation of auto-passed items; board-report samples
driver: sponsors x populations x quarters x sample size
handling_time: 4 min per sampled item; n=59 per population-quarter at 95%/5% zero-deviation [D]
threshold_formula: minutes = S x 2 x 4 x 59 x 4 = S x 1888 min; contracted until > 0.5 FTE; raise n after material errors
peak_factor: after material error or policy change: n increases
authority: attest; cannot fix what it samples
independence: independent of preparer, releaser and policy author
failure_consequence: delegation cannot be renewed without acknowledged report (CNV-GOV-008)
replaces_prior_trigger: new (prior model had no independent reviewer line)

required_activities: bank/custodian/CRM/ERP adapters, feed maintenance, NOC/return-file changes
driver: distinct counterparties (banks, custodians, ERPs) and their change rate, not sponsors
frequency_basis: per new counterparty; per live adapter-year
handling_time: new adapter 160-400 h; upkeep 20-40 h per adapter-year [A]
threshold_formula: FTE = (new_adapters x 280 + live_adapters x 30) / 1,520 h; a repeat counterparty costs ~configuration only
independence: author cannot approve own control-relevant change
sla: adapter fixes before next file cycle
replaces_prior_trigger: replaces 'integration engineer per 8 sponsors': learning curve applies to counterparties

required_activities: S06 onboarding, S07 migration, policy-pack adoption support
driver: new sponsors per year x onboarding minutes(n) with learning curve
handling_time: S06 18,000 min first sponsor -> floor ~9,000 [A]; S07 7,000 + 2 min/account
threshold_formula: onboarding(n) = 9,000 + 9,000 x n^-0.234 (85% curve [A]); FTE = ceil(sum over new sponsors / 82,080); 0 until > 0.5 FTE (CTO/ops absorb)
peak_factor: launch clustering (several sponsors in one quarter)
replaces_prior_trigger: replaces 'implementation analyst per 8 sponsors': driver is new sponsors, not live sponsors

required_activities: S03 incidents, ITGCs, change approvals, break-glass, DR
driver: on-call rota and two-approver change control; volume-insensitive
threshold_formula: >= 3 people able to approve control-relevant changes (author + 2 approvers, CNV-PLT-010), employees or contracted
replaces_prior_trigger: new: change control sets a 3-person engineering floor

required_activities: rostering, coverage, escalations, people management, December readiness gate
driver: human headcount and coverage complexity, not ops count
handling_time: about 15-20% of a manager per 4 direct reports [A]
threshold_formula: dedicated manager when human ops + accounting + compliance headcount >= 7 or founder coordination time > 0.3 FTE; before that founder/controller
authority: roster and assignment; no release rights over own escalations
sla: roster coverage by role and day (CNV-GOV-004)
replaces_prior_trigger: replaces 'ops manager after 4 added ops staff'

required_activities: prep-only queue work; or reserved decisions if appointed by one sponsor
threshold_formula: surge FTE = ceil((peak_day_load - core_FTE x 328) / 328) for last 7 working days
authority: prepare only unless appointed by a single sponsor
